settings.default_intro: Every NOAÉ ritual lives here — hydrating skincare, repairing haircare, calming wellness essentials, and softening body care, formulated with the same ingredient-forward honesty across every category.
settings.aeo_col1_heading: How to choose by skin type
settings.aeo_col1_body: Filter by Skin Type to narrow to formulas suited for Dry, Oily, Combination or All skin types. Most NOAÉ serums and creams work across skin types; masks and clarifying formulas are more targeted.
settings.aeo_col2_body: Orders over ₹1,999 ship free across India in 3-6 business days. Unopened products can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a full refund.
